title: 2.1.19 Count the Equals Signs
description: Fix an if condition that uses a single = where it should compare with ===. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: book 2.1.1: 'The if Statement', Example 2.1 and its Context Pause

steps.title: Run it and watch it lie
steps.instructions: The starter says the alarm should only sound when temperature is 100. Run it. The alarm sounds even though temperature is 20.

steps.title: Fix the condition
steps.instructions: Change the single = in the if condition to === so it asks a question instead of storing a value.

steps.title: Check the variable survived
steps.instructions: Run it again. The last line should now print 20, not 100 - the broken version was overwriting the variable on its way past.

requirements.description: The if condition compares temperature to 100 with ===
